place.bibl: Krishnamurthy, R. The Saints of the Cauvery Delta. New Delhi: Concept Publishing Company, 1979.
place.note: According to locals, it was established by Gaṅgādhara Vājapeyin. It is a small temple located on an agrahāra street in Thiruvalengadu. Until recently, it was looked after by descendants of Gaṅgādhara Vājapeyin. See: Krishnamurthy, R. The Saints of the Cauvery Delta. New Delhi: Concept Publishing Company, 1979, p. 30.
